title: Women Empowerment Livelihood support project
summary: Rajiv Madan ji (ex-member of our club), owner of Daffodils, The Furnishing Gallery provided premium fabric catalogues to our Women Empowerment project.
description: Rajiv Madan ji (ex-member of our club), owner of Daffodils, The Furnishing Gallery provided premium fabric catalogues to our Women Empowerment project. His valuable contribution provides women with the opportunity to transform beautiful fabrics into creative, useful products that can be sold to generate income and support their families. 75 catalogues were handed over to Seva Charitable Trust working with women in need.
